purpose: BH2 W2 red-rule demonstrations: YAML explicit-key (? paths : [...]) and tagged-key (!!str paths: [...]) representations of a paths filter narrowed to README.md must fail the registry check; an unrecognized key inside a trigger mapping can never leave it 'unfiltered'.

demonstrated.mutation: explicit-key form '? paths' / ': [\'README.md\']' on push and pull_request
tagged-key form '!!str paths: [\'README.md\']' on push and pull_request
